'''Tyma Canyon''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Redcap]]. It was the site of [[Redcap]]'s only [[Spaceport/Legends|landing site]], as [[Starship/Legends|starships]] could not land anywhere else due to the thick mud.
